text:
maria: Hey @support, customer on Vercel edge functions is hitting a ReadableStream hang when streaming SSE after our auth token rotates. No errors in app logs, frontend shows stream frozen and then reconnects. request id: req_8f3c2

raj: Can you share the SDK + bundle + runtime versions? Edge vs node?

maria: TS SDK 1.12.0, they bundle with webpack and deploy to Vercel Edge. Also tried Cloudflare. Local Node repro is intermittent.

kyle: 1.12.0 changed fetch/polyfill handling for streams — might be a bundle/runtime mismatch. Are they using the node-targeted bundle in an edge runtime?

maria: Yes, they're using the Node bundle because of server-only helpers. Init snippet: 
```ts
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = await client.stream.create({ model: 'redwood/rt-large' });
for await (const chunk of stream) { console.log(chunk.text); }
```

maria: In Vercel the connection appears to keep sending on server, but client ReadableStream stops yielding after ~30s when our token rotation runs. No thrown exceptions.

devx: Can you reproduce with `vercel dev --edge`? Also capture SSE frames in devtools — is the server still sending event frames?

maria: Reproduced on `vercel dev` and `wrangler dev`. Server continues to emit `data:` frames, but the consumer loop is awaiting forever on the next chunk. Network shows data arriving but the JS loop doesn't get it.

eng-runtime: Pinged runtime team. Sounds like the runtime's fetch ReadableStream may drop callbacks when headers change mid-stream (our SDK refreshes tokens and may re-issue requests or mutate the request object). Do you have the request/response headers?

maria: Sample headers: `transfer-encoding: chunked`, `content-type: text/event-stream`, `x-rw-request-id: req_8f3c2`, `authorization: Bearer <rotated>`

raj: Hypothesis: token rotation triggers our retry middleware which tries to transparently refresh Authorization and resume the same connection. Some edge runtimes (Vercel/Cloudflare) don't support swapping headers on active fetch streams and effectively block the stream consumer.

maria: Quick mitigation we gave the customer: switch to the edge/browser-optimized bundle (no Node polyfills) or pin SDK to 1.11.x which doesn't attempt mid-stream header swaps. They tried `@redwood/inference/browser` and reported the hang stopped.

kyle: We'll open an internal issue to change middleware behavior: on token refresh, open a new connection or perform a clean reconnect instead of mutating ongoing fetch. Filed RW-ISSUE-5932.

maria: Note: customer is on a committed plan and reported extra billed tokens due to client retries while stream hung. They're asking for a refund window/timeline for patch.

eng-runtime: Prioritizing a 1-week hotfix and a docs note for Vercel/Webpack bundling. Also adding CI test that simulates mid-stream auth rotation in our edge emulator.

support-bot: Created internal ticket SUP-34421, assigned to eng-runtime + devx + billing.

maria: I'll attach a minimal repro repo and network trace to SUP-34421. Customer accepted the workaround for now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

kyle: Follow-up action items: 1) runtime test case, 2) SDK hotfix to avoid header mutation mid-stream, 3) docs for bundling target, 4) billing review for SUP-34421.

maria: Uploading repro and marking thread for escalation.
